episode.episode_title: The AI Oversight Proposal and the Lobbying Behind It
episode.episode_description: The Wall Street Journal reports that Mark Zuckerberg, Jensen Huang and Elon Musk spoke with President Trump as a proposed federal AI oversight framework lost momentum. We examine what is reported, what remains uncertain and why it matters.

short.title: Tech Leaders Reportedly Help Stall AI Oversight Proposal
